name: Abduction
overview: Two warring classmates — the young and reckless conspiracy theorist Danil and the popular handsome captain of the hockey team Sergey — encounter mystical phenomena and conspiracies in a small town in the Far East — Amurgrad. The guys have to join forces in the fight against evil spirits in order to save their friends, school, city, and uncover the villains behind everything. But they don't know yet that the mystery they're about to face goes far beyond the boundaries of their small town.
